title: capsicum molle
intro: Capsicum molle, commonly known as Chilean pepper or red pepper, is a plant species belonging to the Capsicum genus and is native to South America. The health benefits of Capsicum molle include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve circulation, and support the digestive system, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum molle include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Capsicum molle include capsanthin, capsorubin, and capsidiol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
